options.reason: The table was evidently assembled to diagnose surface faults: seven binary fault-type indicator columns (Pastry, Z_Scratch, K_Scatch, Stains, Dirtiness, Bumps, Other_Faults) jointly describe the fault status of each row, while all other columns are geometric/luminosity descriptors available before inspection verdicts. Treating the fault indicators as joint outcomes (multilabel) matches the schema, which has no single multi-label fault column. Y_Minimum/Y_Maximum are near-unique per row and are flagged as possible record identifiers rather than predictors.
options.title: multilabel
